title: Providing for the appointment of Antoinette Bush as a citizen regent of the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution.
official_summary: This joint resolution provides for the appointment of Antoinette Bush as a citizen regent of the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution.

summary.headline: Congress appoints Antoinette Bush as a citizen member of the Smithsonian Institution's Board of Regents.
summary.what_it_does: This joint resolution appoints Antoinette Bush as a citizen regent on the Board of Regents, the group that governs the Smithsonian Institution.
